A [[Color/Legends|red]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' was constructed by the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] sometime in his [[Sith training|apprenticeship]] under his [[Darth Tenebrous's Sith Master|master]].

==History==
Darth Tenebrous constructed a red [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during his Sith training, and would go on to wield the weapon when he either sparred or honed his [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] skills.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
